title: Nuclear Extraction from Human Heart Tissue for Single Cell Sequencing
author: Christian Pfleger
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcjqiumw
materials: Pulverize tissue in mortar using pestle and hammer.
Hammer gently, scrape off tissue stuck to pistill.
Aspirate carefully and resuspend in nuclear buffer .

steps.title: Prepare Equipment
steps.instruction: Place the following items on dry ice: flat bottom mortar and pestle, hammer, forceps, sample-flash frozen heart tissue, and scale plate.

steps.title: Pulverize Heart Tissue
steps.instruction: Pulverize the flash-frozen heart tissue using the mortar and pestle.

substeps.instruction: Assemble scale and cover plate with weighing paper.
Transfer tissue immediately into mortar and cover with pestle.

steps.title: Initial Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Transfer the pulverized tissue into a 6 cm dish containing 4 mL cell lysis buffer on ice.

substeps.instruction: Segregate particles and transfer into douncer A using a transfer pipette.
Wash the plate with 2 mL cell lysis buffer and transfer the wash into douncer A.

steps.title: First Filtration
steps.instruction: Filter the contents of douncer A through a 100 µm mesh into a 50 ml Falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Wash douncer A with 2 mL cell lysis buffer and filter the wash as well.

steps.title: Second Filtration
steps.instruction: Transfer the filtered sample into douncer B and filter through a 40 µm mesh into a 50 ml Falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Wash douncer B with 2 mL cell lysis buffer and filter the wash as well.

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample into a 15 ml Falcon tube and centrifuge at 400 x g for 7 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclear Sample
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 600 µL homogenization buffer (D) and mix with Optiprep working solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL Optiprep working solution (30% iodixanol) and mix carefully (C).
Transfer the mixture into a 40 ml centrifugation tube.

steps.title: Perform Density Gradient Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Create an iodixanol gradient and centrifuge to separate nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Carefully underlayer the nuclear sample with 8 mL of 35% iodixanol using a serological pipette.
Carefully underlayer both layers with 4 mL of 40% iodixanol.
Centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 20 minutes at 4 °C with no breaks.

steps.title: Recover and Wash Nuclei
steps.instruction: Collect the nuclei and perform a wash step.

substeps.instruction: Collect the ring of nuclei at the 35% - 40% iodixanol interface.
Add an equal volume of nuclear buffer.
Spin at 500 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Quality Control
steps.instruction: Verify the quality and quantity of the nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Stain 5 µL of the sample and all QC fractions with DAPI.
Check for complete lysis, nuclei morphology, purity, and count.
Note: During testing, collect all 3 phases of Optiprep centrifugation, add the same volume of nuclear buffer, and spin to check separation of nuclei and cell debris; adjust as required.

steps.title: Final Resuspension and Storage
steps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclei and preserve them in methanol.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend nuclei in 100 µL nuclear buffer.
Add 400 µL of 100% methanol (-20 °C) dropwise to the suspension.
Transfer the sample into a -80 °C freezer.
